messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem sync: we're seeing the same sequence across 4 incidents — cache churn, token-service P95 spikes, then autoscaler thrash. Need to turn the postmortem notes into concrete runbook/playbook edits and assign owners.

maria: Agreed. Can we capture a condensed triage flow and a short escalation ladder (who to page at what thresholds)?

anya: I can own the runbook edits. Will create a ticket and a PR with the edits called out as 'Quick triage', 'Deeper remediation', and 'Recovery steps'.

devon: Adding the exact operator commands we used during the last incident so first responders have them verbatim:
```
# quick check: eviction rate and mem pressure
curl -sS "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_eviction_rate%5B1m%5D"
# reduce model batch to limit mem use on pool 'serve-a'
redwoodctl deploy --pool serve-a --set batch_size=6
# set routing to low-mem variant temporarily
redwoodctl route set my-model --variant low-mem-v1
# rollback canary if things worsen
redwoodctl rollout rollback --model my-model --to-version last-stable
```

leo: I'll take dashboards/alerting: add `kv_cache_eviction_rate`, `mem.available`, and `token_latency_p95` panels, plus a suppressed composite alert (require 3m sustained) to avoid flapping. ETA: 72h.

maria: Proposed escalation ladder for the playbook (suggested thresholds):
- advisory: eviction_rate > 1% for 3m -> notify eng-oncall (Slack message)
- urgent: eviction_rate > 3% for 5m OR token_latency_p95 > 1s -> page eng-oncall and SRE-lead
- critical: eviction_rate > 7% for 5m OR sustained autoscaler churn -> page oncall + escalate to infra-ops manager and product incident channel

oncall-bot: IncidentBot: ticket RW-4701 created and assigned to @anya. Due date 2026-04-05.

sam: Can we add a one-line 'first responder' checklist at the top of the runbook? Something like: 1) check eviction + latency 2) run quick mitigations (batch/variant) 3) notify owners 4) open incident ticket if urgent.

anya: Yep. I'll add that one-liner and an owner matrix (who pins variant, who updates routing, who manages scaling/commit changes). Draft PR by EOD tomorrow.

leo: Also adding a playbook note: when you pin to low-mem variant, annotate the change with `#postmortem-RW-4701` so we can correlate with telemetry and revert safely.

maria: Action items summary:
- anya: runbook + playbook edits (ticket RW-4701) — due 2026-04-05
- leo: dashboards & composite alert — due 2026-03-29
- devon: ops snippet doc + `redwoodctl` examples — due EOD today
- sam: escalate ladder and playbook one-liner + link to postmortem — due 2026-03-28

sam: ack. I'll follow up on the PR and add links to the postmortem and the incident timeline.

maria: Thanks all. We'll recheck in after the PR lands and after alerts are live. If RW-4701 hits blockers, @anya please ping the infra-eng lead. :white_check_mark:
